name: Infinity Timetable 2.2.0
notes:
What's new in 2.2.0
- ID cards for learners and staff: 6 designs, photos (one at a time or many at once), QR code or barcode, front and back, A4 sheets or card printer, with preview
- Master timetable: click a lesson and it follows the mouse; drop it on another lesson to swap them, then place the one you picked up
- Right-click on master timetable lessons opens the lesson menu

Updating keeps all your timetables, settings and your licence.
